company.name: VôM
company.shortDescription: VôM is a homegrown accounting software platform.
company.description: VôM is a homegrown accounting software platform that is based out of Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. VôM aims to provide “Value of Money” to small businesses that are focused on easily managing their financials.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based accounting platform for issuing electronic invoices, managing sales, purchases, expenses, and generating financial reports compliant with Saudi tax authorities.
productsAndServices.name: VôM Cloud Accounting Software

productsAndServices.description: A feature within VôM for generating tax-compliant electronic invoices with QR codes, aligned with Saudi Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority requirements.
productsAndServices.name: VôM Electronic Invoicing

productsAndServices.description: Provides multiple accurate and real-time financial reports to support business decision-making and regulatory compliance.
productsAndServices.name: VôM Financial Reporting

productsAndServices.description: Integration capabilities that allow VôM to synchronize sales, purchases, and accounting data automatically with other business systems.
productsAndServices.name: VôM System Integration

productsAndServices.description: An iOS application that allows users to access and manage their accounting records and financial data remotely.
productsAndServices.name: VôM Mobile Application

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,659,956 to $3,659,956, a 1x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 70 (+36 over 90 days) and market heat at 26 (+18).
